coverage_notes.Anthropic: Official https://www.anthropic.com/news newsroom listing; RSS was not validated. Collector extracts only same-host news links with a date from the associated official card, then falls back to Article JSON-LD.
coverage_notes.Rockstar Games: Official https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire Newswire listing; the tag-filtered URL caused an infinite redirect in the 2026-09-26 run. No unofficial source is used. Collector reads dated first-party cards and linked article publication metadata; technical-interest-only remains mandatory.
coverage_notes.IBM: Official https://newsroom.ibm.com/announcements?format=rss&l=50 RSS is attempted first; malformed XML in the 2026-09-26 run led to an official HTML listing fallback at https://newsroom.ibm.com/announcements.
coverage_notes.Oracle: Oracle Blogs returned HTTP 403 to the Actions runner. The configured alternative is Oracle's official press-release RSS feed, linked by https://www.oracle.com/europe/corporate/rss/; it is parsed as RSS and stays on oracle.com. This monitors official product/company releases rather than Oracle employee blog posts.
coverage_notes.Adobe: Official Adobe Newsroom listing https://news.adobe.com/news; the collector uses same-host dated cards and Article JSON-LD as fallbacks. RSS was not validated.
coverage_notes.Qualcomm: Uses the company's official investor-relations press-release listing https://investor.qualcomm.com/news-events/press-releases/default.aspx after the newsroom page's HTML was not parsed reliably; only investor.qualcomm.com/qualcomm.com URLs are accepted.
coverage_notes.xAI: Official https://x.ai/news listing; RSS was not validated. The collector uses dated first-party cards and Article JSON-LD when available.
coverage_notes.Tesla: Official Tesla Blog https://www.tesla.com/blog and regional https://www.tesla.com/en_gb/blog both returned HTTP 403 to the Actions runner on 2026-09-26. No third-party replacement is configured; technology/software-only relevance remains mandatory.
coverage_notes.Google: Coverage is split across Google AI, DeepMind, general Developers, and Android Developers feeds.
coverage_notes.Google Cloud: Official listing https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/gcp currently has no publisher RSS advertised in its HTML response and omits dates from listing cards. Collector tries same-host dated cards and linked article publication metadata; no crawl/update date is substituted.
coverage_notes.Microsoft: Microsoft Source and Azure engineering blog are separate; GitHub is independently monitored.
coverage_notes.Amazon: Corporate/product news is distinct from AWS What's New.
coverage_notes.Meta: Meta Newsroom and Meta Engineering are complemented by the official AI at Meta listing https://ai.meta.com/blog/; dated same-host cards are supported without requiring Article JSON-LD.

topics: relevant technical developments from Rockstar Games
Tesla technology and software only; exclude generic corporate/vehicle news
